attrs.author: Qwen
attrs.summary: Qwen3 Next 80B A3B Thinking is a state-of-the-art mixture-of-experts (MoE) language model with 3 billion activated parameters and 80 billion total parameters. It features a hybrid attention architecture, supports contexts up to 262K tokens, and includes enhanced reasoning capabilities. To ensure sufficient GPU memory capacity, we recommend deploying this model on 2 NVIDIA H200 or 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs.
